PROP-attendanceze-pre-003.text: PKCE code_verifier must be present in cookie before token exchange proceeds.
PROP-attendanceze-pre-003.assertion: forall callback: tokenExchange(code, verifier) => verifier != null && verifier != ''

locations.note: STEM OAuth token endpoint requires code_verifier in POST form data (line 25). Missing verifier triggers 400 invalid_request at line 36. This is the STEM-as-OAuth-server flow, not the Supabase Discord callback.
Verifies S256 PKCE challenge. Method must be S256 (returns false for any other method).
